## Q1
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: NEP 2020 calls for teaching and learning of Indian languages to be integrated with school and higher education at every level.<br>
Statement II: UNESCO has declared 220 Indian languages endangered.

Choose the correct answer.

## Q1 - Options
(A) Both statements are true.
(B) Both statements are false.
(C) Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
(D) Statement I is false but Statement II is true.

## Q1 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Higher Education System
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q41

NEP 2020 promotes Indian languages across educational levels. The commonly cited UNESCO figure is not 220 in this formulation, so Statement II is false.

(D) A, D and E only

**Answer:** C

## Q6
The policy of privatization of higher education began during:

## Q6 - Options
(A) The first five year plan
(B) The third five year plan
(C) The sixth five year plan
(D) The eighth five year plan

## Q6 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Higher Education System
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (11 Mar, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q41

The formal policy encouragement of privatization in higher education gained major momentum during the Eighth Five Year Plan (1992–1997), following the 1991 Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization (LPG) economic reforms. The plan emphasized private sector participation, self-financing institutions, and cost-recovery mechanisms to expand higher education capacity amid public fiscal constraints.

## Q7
Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was associated with the efforts in establishing:

## Q7 - Options
(A) Milind College
(B) Aurangabad college
(C) Maha Bodhi college
(D) Nagpur college

## Q7 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Higher Education System
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (11 Mar, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q42

Dr. B.R. Ambedkar founded the People's Education Society in 1945 to promote higher education among socially and economically disadvantaged communities. Under its aegis, he established Milind Mahavidyalaya (Milind College) in Aurangabad, inaugurated in 1950 on campus grounds named Nagsen Vana, playing a transformative role in regional educational empowerment.

## Q8
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: Constitution allows both central government and state governments to enact laws for the higher education system in India.<br>
Statement II: More than 75% of colleges in the field of higher education are in private sector (government aided and unaided).

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

## Q8 - Options
(A) Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
(B) Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
(C) Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
(D) Statement I is false but Statement II is true.

## Q8 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Higher Education System
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (11 Mar, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q43

Statement I is true because the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 placed education in the Concurrent List (Entry 25, List III of the Seventh Schedule), authorizing both Parliament and State Legislatures to legislate on higher education (subject to Entry 66 of the Union List for coordination of standards). Statement II is true because national reports such as the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) consistently show that private colleges (private-unaided at ~65% and private-aided at ~13%) account for over 78% of all higher education colleges in India.

## Q9
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: The purpose of higher education is to promote critical and creative thinking abilities among students.<br>
Statement II: Deemed Universities can design their own syllabus and course work but cannot grant degrees.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

## Q9 - Options
(A) Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
(B) Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
(C) Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
(D) Statement I is false but Statement II is true.

## Q9 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Higher Education System
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (11 Mar, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q44

Statement I is true because higher education is designed to foster intellectual autonomy, critical inquiry, and creative problem-solving. Statement II is false because institutions recognized as "Deemed to be Universities" under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 enjoy full academic autonomy, which explicitly includes the power to award and confer degrees in their own name under Section 22 of the UGC Act.

## Q10
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: The All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE) was established in 1956 in order to ensure planned and coordinated development of technical education in India.<br>
Statement II: Technical Education was defined as programmes of education in engineering, technology, architecture, town planning, management, pharmacy and applied arts and crafts.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

## Q10 - Options
(A) Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
(B) Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
(C) Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
(D) Statement I is false but Statement II is true.

## Q10 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Higher Education System
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (11 Mar, Shift 2) · Paper 1 · Q45

Statement I is false because AICTE was established as a national advisory body in November 1945 (and conferred statutory status by an Act of Parliament in 1987), whereas 1956 is the year the University Grants Commission (UGC) was established by an Act of Parliament. Statement II is true because Section 2(g) of the AICTE Act defines technical education as programmes of education, research and training in engineering, technology, architecture, town planning, management, pharmacy, and applied arts and crafts.
